answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 27532 Country: India Title: Pls tell me that..... wearing platinum ring with diamond for men is haram or not..... Question: asslamaleykum.....pls tell me that..... wearing platinum ring with diamond for men is haram or not...... Answer ID: 27532 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1653/1190/L=1431) For males, a silver ring weighing less than one misqal i.e. 4 gram 372 milligram is lawful. It is not lawful for male to put on the ring of any other metal other than silver. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
